scenario: The ego vehicle approaches a T-intersection where an adversarial car is waiting to turn left from the side road.

ego.behavior: The car travels straight forward along the main road approaching the T-intersection.

adversarials.behavior: The car remains stationary at the T-intersection stop line on the side road, waiting to turn left onto the main road.

spatial_relation: The ego vehicle is on a straight two-lane main road approaching a T-intersection, while the adversarial car is positioned on the side road at the intersection stop line on the right side of the ego's path.
requirements_and_restrictions: The ego vehicle must maintain a set distance from the intersection upon spawning, and the scenario terminates once the ego vehicle has safely passed through the intersection.

road_side_structures.position: Multiple houses line the left side of the main road along the sidewalk.
Numerous trees are scattered throughout the residential area on the left side of the main road and densely populate the forested area on the right side of the road.

reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: The ego is the green car on the main road from first-person perspective; the blue car at the stop line is the adversarial. 2. Chronology: Initially, ego approaches T-intersection while adversarial waits stationary. Midpoint, ego nears intersection as adversarial remains stopped. Ending, ego passes through intersection. 3. Evidence: The blue car's position is fixed at the stop line across all phases; the green car advances along the main road toward and through the intersection.
